title: [29x]- "You must assign a serial number for item xxx" when trying to reverse Capacity Ledger Entry
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when reversing Capacity Ledger Entry for items requiring serial number assignment, allowing these entries to be reversed without the serial number validation error.
key_points: Resolves incorrect serial number validation when reversing Capacity Ledger Entry
Affects manufacturing item journal posting logic
Issue occurred in BC 29.x and all environments
Test coverage added for the fix
